source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
Spend 1 CP in the opponent's [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as soon as an enemy unit is chosen for a **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**, if it is **engaged** with a **WORLD EATERS CHARACTER** unit of yours. The target is that **CHARACTER** unit.

For the rest of that phase, each enemy unit chosen for a fall-back move while engaged with your unit must make it in **desperate escape** mode. If the retreating unit is **[battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)**, its **[hazard rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hazard-rolls)** for that move get -1.

window.event: enemy unit selected to make a fall-back move while engaged with a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit

effect.recipient: each enemy unit engaged with the target that is selected to make a fall-back move

detail.durationBasis: Core Rules 01.02.02: the effect has no printed duration, so it lasts for the rest of the phase it was used in.
